summary: Review hiring priorities, stalled candidates, evidence gaps, candidate-experience risks, ATS corrections, and whether pipeline coverage can support stated goals.

useCases.title: Review our recruiting pipeline
useCases.message: Review our recruiting pipeline against our hiring goals, show the coverage conclusion and evidence, and recommend the best handoff without starting it.

useCases.title: Check whether hiring is on track
useCases.message: Tell me whether our current candidate pipeline can plausibly support this hiring goal and what deserves attention next.
